positive: A flow imposes avoidable memory, attention, predictability, reading, or recovery load for ADHD, autistic, dyslexic, or other neurodivergent users.
negative: The issue is only color contrast, semantic markup, or translation expansion.

exclusions: Do not flatten personality or remove useful complexity without evidence.
Do not diagnose users or present a profile as a universal rule.

outputs.primary: prioritized cognitive repair ledger preserving product voice

stop_conditions: Stop when the task context or observed friction is unknown.
Hand off semantic/contrast defects to a11y-pass and locale defects to i18n-ready.
